scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Turn-Based Stochastic Mean-Payoff Games in Deterministic Quasipolynomial Time” (preprints/Turn-Based-Stochastic-Mean-Payoff-Games-in-Deterministic-Quasipolynomial-Time-October-5-2026/stochastic-mean-payoff-games.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 104 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 77e967a1db5965db), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are a uniform deterministic Turing machine and an absolute constant C such that, on every valid input described above, the machine outputs exactly U in at most 2C(log2(L+2))2 bit operations. The bound includes input reading, exact rational arithmetic, and output. Vertices of value zero are included.
